question: Should this maintainer-owned replacement be treated as the canonical branch to land for the malformed QA HTTP JSON body issue, superseding https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102079?
rationale: The code shape is correct, but two open PRs still cover the same root cause and this PR has the protected maintainer label, so ClawSweeper should not choose or close the cluster automatically.

options.title: Use this replacement as canonical
options.body: Land this PR after exact-head checks and close the linked issue plus superseded sibling PRs with credit preserved.

options.title: Land the proof-positive sibling
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102079 instead if maintainers prefer keeping the contributor branch as the canonical landing path.

options.title: Pause for consolidation
options.body: Keep all candidates open until maintainers request one final branch with the preferred helper shape and proof.

recommendation.title: Use this replacement as canonical
recommendation.body: Land this PR after exact-head checks and close the linked issue plus superseded sibling PRs with credit preserved.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete authored the maintainer-owned replacement and current blame also points to recent ownership of the affected QA Lab server lines.
